titleBack: At Last We Will Have Revenge

flipToBack.prose: Flip if an opponent's Jedi is PRESENT at an interior Naboo battleground site. Opponent-driven: their Jedi arriving flips you.

children.req: presence (presentAt): opponent Jedi present at interior Naboo battleground site

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction on any table change (singleton); flip additionally retrieves 1 Force
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front (and owner retrieves 1 Force) when opponent has NO Jedi present at any interior Naboo battleground site.

children.req: presence (presentAt): opponent Jedi present at interior Naboo battleground site

requirementSemantics: Both flip directions use PRESENCE (Filters.presentAt), not control/occupy/at: the Jedi must be physically present at the interior Naboo battleground site.
Gate location is a compound: interior Naboo site AND battleground site (Filters.and(Filters.interior_Naboo_site, Filters.battleground_site)).
Flip-back carries a bonus: RetrieveForceEffect(playerId, 1) appended after FlipCardEffect (Card13_073_BACK.java:190-193).
Front control-phase kill action requires PRESENT-WITH: opponent character presentWith your Dark Jedi who is at an interior Theed Palace site (Card13_073.java:96-97).
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Dark_Jedi) (drain protection anchor, kill-action anchor, lightsaber-combat initiator)

Kill-target narrowing mods: LET_THEM_MAKE_THE_FIRST_MOVE__ONLY_TARGET_UNDERCOVER_SPIES_AND_R2D2 -> Filters.or(Filters.undercover_spy, Filters.R2D2); ...ONLY_TARGET_UNDERCOVER_SPIES -> Filters.undercover_spy
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (required on objective deploy): deploy Theed Palace Generator Core (Filters.Theed_Palace_Generator_Core), Theed Palace Generator (Filters.Theed_Palace_Generator), and Deep Hatred (Filters.Deep_Hatred) from Reserve Deck (Card13_073.java:55-79).

No repeatable downloads on either side. Front once per control phase: target one opponent character present with your Dark Jedi at an interior Theed Palace site; target is lost (TargetingReason.TO_BE_LOST, LoseCardFromTableEffect) (Card13_073.java:93-142).

Back once per move phase: your Dark Jedi initiates lightsaber combat vs opponent Jedi present; each draws 2 destiny; loser loses 2 Force (cannot be reduced); if difference >= 5, loss from Reserve Deck and losing character lost (Card13_073_BACK.java:71-173).
otherObligations: Front: opponent may not Force drain where opponent has a Jedi (MayNotForceDrainAtLocationModifier on Filters.sameLocationAs(self, opponents Jedi)) (Card13_073.java:87).
Front: your Force drains at Naboo sites where you have a Dark Jedi may not be canceled (Card13_073.java:88).
Back DRAWBACK: you may not Force drain OR initiate battle at any location where you have a Dark Jedi (Card13_073_BACK.java:64-67). Flipping to back shuts down your own Dark Jedi drains.
No hard-lose/out-of-play condition on either side.

missingStateCalculation: The front flip-progress rule is deliberately opponent-driven. It reports the source condition but never masquerades as a route that the owner can complete by deploying or moving a Dark Jedi.

The front payoff is executable only during the owner's control phase at an interior Theed Palace site where the exact target survives both current game-text narrowing modifications and TargetingReason.TO_BE_LOST.

The back payoff is executable only during the owner's move phase. It may occur at any location, not merely the interior Naboo battleground keeping the objective flipped, and both duelists must be legal objective targets.
flipPreservation: A typed Dark Jedi deploy parent beats generic deployment and Pass when the candidate has a direct legal deploy to a front target-loss pairing or a back lightsaber-combat pairing. A stranded active Dark Jedi no longer suppresses a useful hand copy; the exception closes once an active Dark Jedi has an executable pairing.

Destination scoring sends the Dark Jedi to the exact legal opponent location. Movement starts a safe route, rewards the exact destination, and holds an already executable pairing; Formation Safety's doomed-solo veto remains dominant.

Standalone and combined battle Force-loss selection retain exactly the first typed Dark Jedi in hand while no active Dark Jedi is on table. Once a typed Dark Jedi is active, ordinary duplicate and loss priorities resume.
The exact front Target character action and back Initiate lightsaber combat action beat Pass and ordinary same-phase alternatives only when their source objective, face, and action text all match.
runtimeOwners: ObjectiveAnalyzer owns family identity, exact setup hydration, opponent-driven flip state, phase-windowed payoff state, source-modified target legality, deploy feasibility, stranded-copy recovery, and Force-loss retention facts.

NabooDuelObjectivePolicy owns the bounded exact-action scores and front deploy-destination score. MoveDestinationPolicy owns safe start, exact destination, and established-pair retention contributions.
Mirrored Rando and Chosen One ActionTextEvaluator, CardSelectionEvaluator, DeployEvaluator, and MoveEvaluator adapters consume the same shared facts and policies.
contradictions: The owner cannot force the objective to flip by staging a Dark Jedi. Only an opponent Jedi at the source-defined gate causes the front flip.
The front target-loss site is any interior Theed Palace site with a legal opponent character. It is not limited to the specific interior Naboo battleground where an opponent Jedi caused the flip.
The back lightsaber combat may occur at any location. Restricting it to an interior Naboo battleground would silently discard legal source actions.
13_65 Deep Hatred is an Epic Event. Its storage in startingEffects is a legacy data-bucket convention, not a card-type claim.
